description: Use when an agent must normalize or translate a South Korean address (shipping, checkout, KYC forms). Input: q (Korean address or part of one, e.g. road name + number or neighborhood + lot number), optional limit (1-5). Output: JSON matches with official road-name and lot-number addresses in Korean and English, postal code, building name, admin and road codes. Data: Ministry of the Interior road-name address API. Example: ?q=테헤란로 152 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

q.description: Korean address or part of it (2+ chars; at most 40 Korean characters; no SQL words or % = > < [ ]); bad input → 400, not charged

name: kr_address
title: Korean address lookup: official road-name address, English address and postal code
